newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan mutual funds' assets up 700 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan mutual funds' assets up 700 pct in 1996.

text.p: Mutual funds operating in Venezuela registered a 700 percent growth in assets in 1996 compared with the year before, at 67.21 billion bolivars, the Venezuelan Association of Funds Societies (AVAF) said.
Average yield for the 13 mutual funds operating in the country was 70.18 percent, up from 39.39 percent in 1995.
"This exponential growth means we ended the year with about 20,000 shareholders compared with 6,000 a year before," AVAF President Yanida Canizales told a news conference.
AVAF forecasts another boom year in 1997, as mutual funds get more exposure in Venezuela. It predicted they would attract up to 350 billion bolivars and an additional 55,000 shareholders.
